hero.title: Business Management in Mauritius
hero.subtitle: Studying for a **Bachelor’s and Master’s in Business Management in Mauritius for Indian Students** can help students develop the knowledge and practical skills needed to work in corporate organisations, manage teams, start a business, or pursue international career opportunities. Mauritius offers business-related programmes through institutions such as Middlesex University Mauritius, the Open University of Mauritius, Rushmore Business School, and the University of Mauritius.

overview: Students can choose an undergraduate degree in Business Management and then progress to a postgraduate qualification such as an MSc in Management, Master of Business Administration (MBA), or Executive MBA. The best option depends on academic background, career goals, budget, and preferred study format. Students planning to **study Business Management in Mauritius** can compare the available programmes and choose a qualification that matches their future career plans. **Edu-Hawk Worldwide** helps students explore international education opportunities and understand the admission process.

faq.question: How long does a Bachelor’s in Business Management take in Mauritius?
faq.answer: Many full-time bachelor’s programmes take around three years. Some specialisations or flexible study routes may take longer. For example, the Open University of Mauritius lists a duration of three to six years for its BSc (Hons) Business Management.

faq.question: How long does a Master’s in Business Management take in Mauritius?
faq.answer: It depends on the qualification and institution. Middlesex University Mauritius lists its MSc Management as one year full-time or two years part-time. The University of Mauritius lists its MBA as a two-year part-time programme.

faq.question: What is the tuition fee for Business Management in Mauritius?
faq.answer: Business Management Fees in Mauritius vary considerably. Examples include £5,800 for the Middlesex BA (Hons) Business Management, US$7,500peryearfortheRushmoreBA(Hons)BusinessManagement,andUS$6,840 total for the Open University’s international non-SADC BSc (Hons) Business Management. Always confirm the fee applicable to your nationality and intake.

faq.question: Can international students apply for Business Management courses in Mauritius?
faq.answer: Yes. Institutions such as Middlesex University Mauritius and Rushmore Business School publish international student fee information. Applicants should confirm academic eligibility, English-language requirements, application deadlines, and study-permit procedures directly with the institution.

faq.question: Is an MBA better than an MSc in Management?
faq.answer: Neither is automatically better. An MBA may suit applicants seeking broader business leadership and management development, while an MSc Management may suit graduates who want to deepen their management knowledge. Compare entry requirements, curriculum, cost, duration, professional experience expectations, and recognition before deciding.
